column1: # CITES Appendices I, II and III: the plant (FLORA) listings, transcribed by hand (round eighty-seven, stage 2; the
# sources agent). Read by src/lib/dossier/cites.ts. The Appendices are the Convention's own text, published by CITES at
# https://cites.org/eng/app/appendices.php. Never from Species+ or the CITES Checklist (checklist.cites.org), whose terms
# (read 9 November 2026 at https://checklist.cites.org/terms_of_use_page_en.html) forbid redistributing their data, any
# derivative work and commercial use without the Secretariat's and UNEP's written permission.
# What was read (9 November 2026): cites.org answers a script with a browser check (HTTP 403), so the edition in force,
# "Appendices I, II and III valid from 5 March 2026" (https://cites.org/sites/default/files/eng/app/2026/E-Appendices-2026-03-05.pdf),
# could not be read here. The rows are the FLORA pages (pp. 61-79) of the edition valid from 7 February 2025, read from
# the copy the North American Rock Garden Society keeps (https://www.nargs.org/files/pages/cites_flora_e-appendices-2025-02-07.pdf,
# 384,051 bytes, md5 d93e60c5e6c0221e6a882427d2dca031; its PDF names the CITES Secretariat as author, made 7 February
# 2025), with the plant amendments of CoP20 (Samarkand, 24 November to 5 December 2025; in force 5 March 2026) added as
# CITES Notification to the Parties No. 2026/005 gives them (https://cites.org/sites/default/files/notifications/E-Notif-2026-005.pdf),
# read from the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's notice PB 26-001 of 13 January 2026, which lists them
# Rows from the Notification say so in `source`. Appendix III changes between the two editions are not in the
# Notification: the owner's check below is what finds them.
# The check (10 November 2026): the edition in force, "valid from 5 March 2026", downloaded by the owner from cites.org
# (E-Appendices-2026-03-05.pdf, 2,003,006 bytes, md5 below), its FLORA pages (pp. 61-79) read row by row against this
# table, every field (Appendix, name, annotation, parenthesis, braces, Party): 233 rows as they were. Corrected to the
# edition, each citing its page: the aloe segregates of CoP20 printed by name (Aloidendron pillansii and Aloestrela
# suzannae in Appendix I for Aloe pillansii and Aloe suzannae; Aloe rugosquamosa in Appendix I, no longer a variety of
# Aloe compressa; Aloiampelos, Aloidendron, Aristaloe, Gonialoe and Kumara spp. in Appendix II), the four Aloe species
# the Notification moved to Appendix II no longer printed apart (Aloe spp. holds them), Anacampseros spp. under
# ANACAMPSEROTACEAE including Avonia spp. (whose own row is gone), Nardostachys jatamansi for N. grandiflora, and
# Podocarpus parlatorei's parenthesis, which the edition does not print (its P7 says the zero quota). No Appendix III row
# The table is applied to the pages only when the line `checked:` below names the edition in force it was checked
# against, row by row, and that file's md5 (the owner's step, docs/STAGE2-OWNER-87.md). Until then every page says
# Columns (tab-separated): appendix, taxon as the Appendices print it, annotation signs, the listing's parenthesis or
# braces verbatim, the Party of an Appendix III listing, names excepted (";"), names included (";"), a rule this code
# reads (genera:… the genera a family listing names, by the Appendices' family header; narrow:… genera whose species
# Kew has moved into the listed genus, which the listing is not read to take; succulent, "succulent species only";
# infra, "includes infraspecific taxa"), the family header it stands under, where the row was read, and its URL.
